headline: Congress in summer recess mode: pro forma sessions as lawmakers return Thursday

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate convened in pro forma session on Monday morning for just 33 seconds before adjourning until Thursday. No legislation was debated or voted on during the brief procedural meeting.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House met for a quick pro forma session Monday morning, adjourning after 2 minutes. Twelve new bills and three resolutions were introduced, but no votes were held as the chamber prepares for its August recess.
